CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE csvdatasource
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://nicdatalake11.blob.core.windows.net/data'
)

DROP EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE csvdatasource
DROP EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT csvformat
DROP EXTERNAL TABLE csvExtTable

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT csvformat
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS(
        FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
        FIRST_ROW = 2
    )
)


CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE csvExtTable
(
    [Correlationid] varchar(200),
    [Operationname] varchar(300),
    [Status] varchar(100),
    [Eventcategory] varchar(100),
    [Level] varchar(100),
    [Time] varchar(100),
    [Subscription] varchar(200),
    [Eventinitiatedby] varchar(1000),
    [Resourcetype] varchar(300),
    [Resourcegroup] varchar(1000),
    [Resource] varchar(2000)
)
WITH
(
    LOCATION = '/ActivityLog01.csv',
    DATA_SOURCE = csvdatasource,
    FILE_FORMAT = csvformat
)


SELECT * FROM csvExtTable where Time = '2024-05-30T15:08:15.922Z'
